title: Privacy notice
intro: This notice explains what happens to the details you share through this website.

sections.heading: What I collect
sections.body: If you send an enquiry, I receive what you type into the form: your name, organisation or event, email address, and the details of your request. Nothing else is collected through the forms.

sections.heading: Why I collect it
sections.body: Only to read and reply to your enquiry. I do not add you to a mailing list, sell your details or share them for marketing.

sections.heading: Where it goes
sections.body: Form submissions are sent through Web3Forms, a form-delivery service, which forwards them to my inbox. My email address is not shown on this site.

sections.heading: How long I keep it
sections.bodyNote: State a retention period, e.g. 'I keep enquiry emails for up to 24 months, then delete them.'

sections.heading: Analytics
sections.body: This site counts visits with GoatCounter, which does not use cookies and does not collect personal information. It records which pages are viewed and which buttons are pressed, in aggregate.

sections.heading: Your choices
sections.body: To see or delete what you sent me, message me on LinkedIn and I will act on your request.
